QuestInfo.name: Puppeteer Detector
QuestInfo.1: #b#p 1103004##k wants to check if the old Puppeteer Detector is broken or not. She wants you to go to a #bplace where the detector reacts#k, and defeat the #rmonsters#k there, if there are any... First, go to #b#m102010000##k.
QuestInfo.2: The Detector still works! The #rPuppeteer#k seems to be quite active at #b#m102000000##k as well... What could the Puppeteer be after? Is he really thinking about #rattacking the town#k?

0.0: So, my job is to stand here and monitor the #bPuppeteer Detector#k, which searches nearby areas for spikes in the puppeteer's energy. Well, I #brecently#k noticed that the machine's been beeping like crazy!
0.1: I mean, it could've been doing that for weeks, but I hadn't really been paying attention. The machine might be broken, too, but just in case it's not...
0.2: Someone had better check it out! I'd go myself, but then who would stay here to listen to the machine beep, right? That leaves you!

yes.0: The machine detected activity along #b#m102010000##k. Maybe you should eliminate some #rmonsters#k there and see if you can figure out what's going on.

no.0: But #p1103001# said I could #bcount on you#k! I'm going to slap him the next time he tries to dream-message me!

1.0: So the machine actually works... That's cool, I guess. I never thought we'd find droves of #rmonsters#k so close to town. Do you think the Puppeteer wants to attack us?

mob.0: You go to #b#m102010000##k while I stand here and listen to the machine beep. It's hard work, you know.
